title: agent_retrospective_run/v1
description: Schema for a single agent-retrospective run. A run is modeled as a bounded observation (docs/adr/0007-agent-retrospective-boundaries.md, Decision 1), NOT as a single atomic snapshot: the repository source is an immutable snapshot anchored at run_identity.base_sha, but GitHub/web sources are paginated and can change mid-collection, so each source's observation window and pagination completeness must be recorded independently in source_observations. This schema is the state primary record for a run; docs/dev/agent-retro-index.md (agent_retro_index/v1) remains a derived index only and is not a state store (ADR 0007, Decision 7).

run_identity.description: Identity of the run as a whole. base_sha anchors the repository-source immutable snapshot; source_set_digest is a deterministic digest over source_observations (see compute_source_set_digest() in validate_retrospective_schema.py) intended for idempotency use only ((repo, base_sha, source_set_digest, scope) duplicate suppression, ADR 0007 Decision 5). It is NOT an optimistic-concurrency / stale-write-protection token; that mechanism (expected_previous_digest / version) is out of scope for this schema (Child 5 / #2238 responsibility).

base_sha.description: Full-length repository commit SHA the run is anchored to. Repository-source claims are treated as an immutable snapshot at this commit.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this run record was generated.

runtime_version.description: Version identifier of the agent-retrospective runtime that produced this run.

source_set_digest.description: Deterministic sha256 hex digest computed over source_observations by compute_source_set_digest(). Used for idempotency (duplicate suppression) only -- not for optimistic concurrency.

source_observations.description: Per-source bounded observation records. Required so a run is never mistaken for a single atomic snapshot (ADR 0007 Decision 1).

source_type.description: Kind of source observed. 'repository' is treated as an immutable snapshot anchored at run_identity.base_sha (observed_from/observed_until are optional for this source_type). Non-repository sources (github/web/runtime) are paginated / time-varying and MUST record observed_from/observed_until.

observed_from.description: Start of the observation window (ISO 8601). Required for non-repository source_type values.

observed_until.description: End of the observation window (ISO 8601). Required for non-repository source_type values.

fetch_started_at.description: Acquisition window start: wall-clock time this source's API collection began (ADR 0007 Decision 1, distinct from resource_updated_at_min/max).

fetch_completed_at.description: Acquisition window end: wall-clock time this source's API collection completed.

resource_updated_at_min.description: Resource-event window minimum: earliest last-updated timestamp among the collected resources.

resource_updated_at_max.description: Resource-event window maximum: latest last-updated timestamp among the collected resources.

pagination_completeness.description: Whether pagination traversal for this source completed. 'partial' MUST be accompanied by partial_reason.

partial_reason.description: Reason pagination was cut short (e.g. rate_limit, timeout). Present when pagination_completeness is 'partial'.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor / continuation token, when available, for reproducibility and diffing.

etag.description: ETag or equivalent identity metadata for change detection, when available.

endpoint.description: API endpoint queried for this source.

api_version.description: API version used for this source's collection.

query_params.description: Filter / query parameters applied when collecting this source.

page_size.description: Page size used for this source's collection.
